paper_title: Lattice QCD input for axion cosmology
coupling_convention: m_a in eV vs f_a in GeV
notes: This lattice QCD paper derives a lower bound on the axion mass (m_a >= 14.6 ueV, equivalently f_a <= 4.10e11 GeV) from pure-glue topological susceptibility and the misalignment mechanism (post-inflation PQ breaking). This is a single cosmological bound point rather than an exclusion curve; the main results are dimensionless ratios (chi/Tc^4 vs T/Tc), not a coupling-vs-mass exclusion plot. The bound is a single (f_a, m_a) point: f_a=4.10e11 GeV, m_a=1.46e-5 eV. No mass-vs-coupling curve exists to extract as data_points, so I leave data_points empty with low extraction confidence.
